leftEvidence.title: Luke places prayer and an exodus conversation on the mountain

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: About eight days after the sayings Jesus takes Peter, John, and James up the mountain to pray; his face changes and his clothing flashes white.
points.right: The next day a father begs for his only child after the disciples cannot cast out a spirit; Jesus rebukes it and returns the child.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Moses and Elijah speak of his departure to be completed at Jerusalem; sleepy disciples see glory, Peter proposes tents, a cloud brings fear, and the voice names the chosen Son.
points.right: While all marvel, Jesus predicts betrayal, but the saying is concealed and the disciples fear asking about it.

payload.posture: Luke moves from seen glory and the chosen Son to a father’s only child, healing, amazement, and concealed understanding.

rightEvidence.role: From glory into distress and another death prediction
rightEvidence.title: Luke places the only child and hidden saying after the mountain

payload.tension: Public marvel does not produce understanding of the betrayal prediction.
payload.title: Glory, an only child, and a concealed saying
